name: comanda
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Design a polished native Android application called RachaConta for Brazilian university friends dividing a boteco bill equally. Create ONE coherent visual direction, Comanda da esquina, shown through TWO complete screens side by side. Each screen has a 390 x 844 logical portrait viewport, combined board approximately 804 x 844 with narrow neutral gutter. Render actual app content only, no phones, OS status bars, notches, device shadows, external captions or presentation labels.

This concept is orderly and comanda-led, evoking a friendly neighborhood bar menu without looking like an advertisement. Warm pale-paper ground, rich wine-red headers and actions, muted golden-yellow accents. A compact bold Brazilian painted-sign wordmark pairs with clean sans UI text. A single flat ruled receipt surface defines the result; understated thin rules organize the form. No illustrations or decorative slogans; use 14–16sp body type and familiar Android switches with 48dp touch areas.

Left screen reading order: compact “RachaConta”; headline “Fecha a conta com a turma”; editable “Valor da conta” displaying “R$ 100,00”; “Pessoas” with minus, 3, plus; compact row “Serviço opcional” with Android switch OFF and editable inactive “10%”; helper “Só se ainda não estiver na conta.”; “Nome do encontro (opcional)” with “Pizza de sexta”; primary “Calcular divisão”; subtle text action “Usar exemplo”.

Right: back arrow and “Resultado”; receipt header “Pizza de sexta”; aligned breakdown “Conta R$ 100,00”, “Serviço R$ 0,00”, “Total R$ 100,00”, “Pessoas 3”; then prominent section “Cada um paga” with exactly “2 pessoas · R$ 33,33” and “1 pessoa · R$ 33,34”; helper “Os centavos fecham o total.” Below the receipt, familiar switch OFF labeled “Incluir serviço de 10%”, and “Editar conta”. Crisp readable Brazilian Portuguese, clear hierarchy and generous spacing. Flat modern surfaces without nested cards, torn-paper edges, payments, history, tabs or extra features.
